units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:2:5">Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ</cite> <he>משרבת ת׳ בציפורין וכ׳</he> when rivalry (between the families) increased in Sepphoris, they arranged that the families should pass by, and the mourners stand.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:4">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:4">XIV</cite>), 4; Y. ib. XVI, 15ᶜ bot. <he>ספרי מינין שמטילין איבה ות׳ וכ׳</he> the heretical books which cast enmity, and strife, and dissensions between Israel and their father in heaven.
Y. Yeb. IV, 5ᵈ top ת׳ באחין שכר לאחין (not באחין) by strife between brothers (the yabam and his brother’s spurious son), the brothers (the yabam’s heirs) profit, v. שִׁיפְיוּת.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5:12">Deut. R. s. 5</cite> <he>ומה אם העליונים … ולא ת׳ וכ׳</he> if the heavenly creatures that have no jealousy, or hatred, or strife need peace &c.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 773:8">Yalk. Num. 773</cite> <he>שכא תהא ת׳ וכ׳</he> that there be no strife among the tribes; a. fr.
